section_summary.extract_value: This section describes translation/back-translation of the BAS-2 into Persian and a single data collection conducted between December 2014 and June 2015 at seven universities in Tehran, Iran. Participants were university students who completed a paper-and-pencil survey in classroom settings; the BAS-2 was used (BAS-2), and no sample size, age, BMI, racial composition, or correlations with BMI are reported in this section.
